properties.name: 緑駅 駅舎

detail_confidence.position_orientation: sourced from Spatial Index JP.01.546.MIDORI/STATION_BUILDING at runtime (Directive 10 AC08) — NOT this feature's own geometry field, which is a non-authoritative mirror only
detail_confidence.roof_ridge_direction_east_west: B (inference, spec v1.2 section 4.3 — newly defined this pass, corrects Directive 08's undefined/wrong assumption)
detail_confidence.eave_height_3.5m: B (inference — corrected in v1.2 section 13 from the v1.1 figure of 2.8m, which had misread the ground reference line)
detail_confidence.ridge_height_4.5m: B (inference — newly defined in v1.2; v1.1 left this undefined and Directive 08 invented a placeholder value)
detail_confidence.vertical_boards_count_4: B (secondary_photo, undated — only 2 confirmed in the 2009 photo)
detail_confidence.mural_continuous_band: A (contemporary_photo, spec v1.2 section 4.8 explicit — continuous, not fragmentary)
detail_confidence.window_layout_vs_signboard_distinction: A (configuration/count) / C-U (individual window dimensions) — spec v1.2 section 4.6 explicit that windows and signboards are different elements

properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.2 section 4 (Directive 10 rebuild, correcting the Directive 08 implementation, which did not match v1.1 due to (1) v1.1 never defining roof ridge direction/pitch/ridge height, forcing an invented placeholder, and (2) an eave-height measurement error in v1.1 itself, corrected in v1.2 section 13). Roof ridge now runs along the depth axis (east-west, perpendicular to the facade) per v1.2 section 4.3 — not the width axis Directive 08 used. Absolute position/orientation is sourced from the Spatial Index at runtime (Directive 10 section 2/AC08), not hardcoded here; this feature's own `geometry` is a non-authoritative mirror of the Index point.
properties.roof_ridge_axis: depth (east-west, perpendicular to the facade) — spec v1.2 section 4.3

properties.name: 緑駅 構内踏切
properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §5/§6. Existence and board-crossing material are contemporary_photo/encyclopedia (A/B per spec §5); this feature's exact position/extent (spanning between the two platform footprints) is this session's placement, not surveyed.

properties.name: 緑駅 鉄道コンテナ
properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §8: form/dimensions of the container are Unknown. Rendered as a 12ft-class approximate box per the spec's own explicit instruction (§4.3 of Directive 08): "形式不明、外観から12ft級と推定（C）". Color/rust and presence in the gravel area north of the building are the photo-sourced facts; the box's precise dimensions are not.

properties.name: 緑駅前広場 緑色舗装
properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §8: that the plaza pavement is painted green is confidence A (contemporary_photo). This polygon's extent/shape, however, is this session's own placement convenience — the spec gives no dimensions or surveyed boundary for the plaza, so the feature is held at confidence C overall (the weaker of the two claims bundled into one polygon).
